set.definition: select "ontology"."node_version"."id", "ontology"."node_version"."version", "ontology"."node_version"."action", "ontology"."node"."type", "ontology"."work_version"."title", "ontology"."node_version"."timestamp", "version_zero"."timestamp" as "created_at" from "ontology"."work_version" inner join "ontology"."node_version" on (("ontology"."work_version"."id" = "ontology"."node_version"."id") and ("ontology"."work_version"."version" = "ontology"."node_version"."version")) inner join "ontology"."node" on "ontology"."work_version"."id" = "ontology"."node"."id" inner join "ontology"."node_version" "version_zero" on (("ontology"."work_version"."id" = "version_zero"."id") and ("version_zero"."version" = 0)) left join "ontology"."book_version" on (("ontology"."work_version"."id" = "ontology"."book_version"."id") and ("ontology"."work_version"."version" = "ontology"."book_version"."version")) left join "ontology"."essay_version" on (("ontology"."work_version"."id" = "ontology"."essay_version"."id") and ("ontology"."work_version"."version" = "ontology"."essay_version"."version")) where ((not exists (select 1 from "ontology"."node_version" "newer" where (("newer"."id" = "ontology"."work_version"."id") and ("newer"."version" > "ontology"."work_version"."version")))) and ((((("ontology"."node"."type" = 'book') and (("ontology"."book_version"."id" is not null)))) or ((("ontology"."node"."type" = 'essay') and (("ontology"."essay_version"."id" is not null)))))))

select "ontology"."node_version"."id", "ontology"."node_version"."version", "ontology"."node_version"."action", "ontology"."node"."type", "ontology"."collection_version"."name", "ontology"."node_version"."timestamp", "version_zero"."timestamp" as "created_at", case "ontology"."node"."type" when 'volume' then "ontology"."volume_version"."label" when 'supplement' then "ontology"."supplement_version"."label" when 'pamphlet' then "ontology"."pamphlet_version"."label" end as "label" from "ontology"."collection_version" inner join "ontology"."node_version" on (("ontology"."collection_version"."id" = "ontology"."node_version"."id") and ("ontology"."collection_version"."version" = "ontology"."node_version"."version")) inner join "ontology"."node" on "ontology"."collection_version"."id" = "ontology"."node"."id" inner join "ontology"."node_version" "version_zero" on (("ontology"."collection_version"."id" = "version_zero"."id") and ("version_zero"."version" = 0)) left join "ontology"."series_version" on (("ontology"."collection_version"."id" = "ontology"."series_version"."id") and ("ontology"."collection_version"."version" = "ontology"."series_version"."version")) left join "ontology"."volume_version" on (("ontology"."collection_version"."id" = "ontology"."volume_version"."id") and ("ontology"."collection_version"."version" = "ontology"."volume_version"."version")) left join "ontology"."supplement_version" on (("ontology"."collection_version"."id" = "ontology"."supplement_version"."id") and ("ontology"."collection_version"."version" = "ontology"."supplement_version"."version")) left join "ontology"."pamphlet_version" on (("ontology"."collection_version"."id" = "ontology"."pamphlet_version"."id") and ("ontology"."collection_version"."version" = "ontology"."pamphlet_version"."version")) left join "ontology"."series" on "ontology"."collection_version"."id" = "ontology"."series"."id" where ((not exists (select 1 from "ontology"."node_version" "newer" where (("newer"."id" = "ontology"."collection_version"."id") and ("newer"."version" > "ontology"."collection_version"."version")))) and ((((("ontology"."node"."type" = 'volume') and (("ontology"."series_version"."id" is not null)) and (("ontology"."volume_version"."id" is not null)) and (("ontology"."series"."id" is not null)))) or ((("ontology"."node"."type" = 'supplement') and (("ontology"."series_version"."id" is not null)) and (("ontology"."supplement_version"."id" is not null)) and (("ontology"."series"."id" is not null)))) or ((("ontology"."node"."type" = 'pamphlet') and (("ontology"."pamphlet_version"."id" is not null)))))))

select "ontology"."node_version"."id", "ontology"."node_version"."version", "ontology"."node_version"."action", "ontology"."node"."type", "ontology"."collection_version"."name", "ontology"."series"."code", "ontology"."series_version"."cadence", "ontology"."node_version"."timestamp", "version_zero"."timestamp" as "created_at" from "ontology"."series_version" inner join "ontology"."node_version" on (("ontology"."series_version"."id" = "ontology"."node_version"."id") and ("ontology"."series_version"."version" = "ontology"."node_version"."version")) inner join "ontology"."node" on "ontology"."series_version"."id" = "ontology"."node"."id" inner join "ontology"."node_version" "version_zero" on (("ontology"."series_version"."id" = "version_zero"."id") and ("version_zero"."version" = 0)) inner join "ontology"."collection_version" on (("ontology"."series_version"."id" = "ontology"."collection_version"."id") and ("ontology"."series_version"."version" = "ontology"."collection_version"."version")) inner join "ontology"."series" on "ontology"."series_version"."id" = "ontology"."series"."id" left join "ontology"."volume_version" on (("ontology"."series_version"."id" = "ontology"."volume_version"."id") and ("ontology"."series_version"."version" = "ontology"."volume_version"."version")) left join "ontology"."supplement_version" on (("ontology"."series_version"."id" = "ontology"."supplement_version"."id") and ("ontology"."series_version"."version" = "ontology"."supplement_version"."version")) where ((not exists (select 1 from "ontology"."node_version" "newer" where (("newer"."id" = "ontology"."series_version"."id") and ("newer"."version" > "ontology"."series_version"."version")))) and ((((("ontology"."node"."type" = 'volume') and (("ontology"."volume_version"."id" is not null)))) or ((("ontology"."node"."type" = 'supplement') and (("ontology"."supplement_version"."id" is not null)))))))
